themes.title: Internal divisions challenge right-wing party unity
themes.blurb: Right-wing and far-right parties across Europe and South America face growing internal fractures, power struggles, and splinter movements. Coalition friction in Italy, leadership rivalries and local leader revolts in Argentina, party defections in Hungary, and parliamentary realignments in Poland highlight rising volatility within conservative blocs.

themes.title: Far-right parties gain ground in regional and national polls
themes.blurb: Far-right parties across Northern Europe and the UK continue to show strong polling momentum ahead of upcoming local, regional, and national elections. From Germany's AfD dominating state polls to Norway's FrP doubling traditional conservative rivals, populist right platforms are capitalizing on voter dissatisfaction with established governments.

themes.title: Right-wing governments target social programs amid fiscal debates

themes.title: Far-right parties push anti-immigration policies amid border crises
themes.blurb: Right-wing leaders and administrations are escalating border enforcement measures and tightening restrictions on foreign nationals. From worldwide visa suspensions and strict screening criteria in the US to localized obligations for asylum seekers in Italy, hardline anti-immigration rhetoric remains a central policy pillar.
